'''Gudja United Football Club''' is a [[Malta|Maltese]] [[football (soccer)|football]] club from the south-eastern village of [[Gudja]], that currently plays in the [[Maltese Premier League]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Real Madrid’s President’s niece acquires Gudja Utd FC |url=https://www.independent.com.mt/articles/2013-06-17/news/real-madrids-presidents-niece-acquires-gudja-united-fc-1844314112/ |access-date=2024-02-19 |website=The Malta Independent}}</ref>

The team play in blue and white striped jerseys. Their arch-rivals are [[Għaxaq F.C.]].

They have spent 5 seasons in the Premier league."}}
